rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a field of economic activity.

example.traditional: 而家金融行業競爭好激烈。

rows.note: Use this specifically for the public sector rather than an industry in general.

example.traditional: 公營部門嘅人工未必高過私營部門。

rows.note: Use this specifically for the private sector rather than an industry in general.
